proof.text: Choose the supplied exteriorSheaf family phiU with its formula. Let e be the tensor of exteriorSheafPowerIso for S.X1 in degree r1 and S.X3 in degree r3, and d the comparison for S.X2 in degree r2. Set psiU(U) = e.inv followed by phiU(U) followed by d.hom. Tensor-section naturality and the inverse wedge formulas reduce its required formula to the supplied formula; applying d.hom and the forward wedge formula proves the official formula.
Apply the official determinant_wedgeMorphism_glue_family to psiU and its formula. It supplies a global morphism psi with the official wedge formula.

Set phi = e.hom followed by psi followed by d.inv. Tensor-section naturality and the forward wedge comparisons reduce its value on the original wedge tensor to psi on the official wedge tensor. Apply the official global formula and then the inverse wedge comparison. This proves the unchanged exteriorSheaf conclusion on every open. All comparisons exist in degree zero and on empty opens as well.

title: Gluing local wedge morphisms
statement: Under the same hypotheses, any family of local wedge morphisms satisfying the prescribed formula on each open glues to a global sheaf morphism satisfying that formula on every open.

lean.statement:
theorem determinant_wedgeMorphism_of_local_data {X : Scheme.{v}} (S : ShortComplex X.Modules)
    (hS : S.ShortExact) (r₁ r₂ r₃ : ℕ) (hr : r₂ = r₁ + r₃)
    [S.X₁.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank r₁]
    (hlocal : ∀ (U : X.Opens), ∃ φU : exteriorSheaf S.X₁ r₁ ⊗ exteriorSheaf S.X₃ r₃ ⟶
      exteriorSheaf S.X₂ r₂,
      ∀ (a : Fin r₁ → S.X₁.val.obj (op U))
        (b : Fin r₃ → S.X₃.val.obj (op U)) (c : Fin r₃ → S.X₂.val.obj (op U)),
        (∀ i, S.g.val.app (op U) (c i) = b i) →
        φU.val.app (op U)
          (tmulSection (exteriorSheafSection S.X₁ r₁ U a)
            (exteriorSheafSection S.X₃ r₃ U b)) =
          exteriorSheafSection S.X₂ r₂ U
            (fun i ↦ Fin.append (fun j ↦ S.f.val.app (op U) (a j)) c (Fin.cast hr i))) :
    ∃ φ : exteriorSheaf S.X₁ r₁ ⊗ exteriorSheaf S.X₃ r₃ ⟶ exteriorSheaf S.X₂ r₂,
      ∀ (U : X.Opens) (a : Fin r₁ → S.X₁.val.obj (op U))
        (b : Fin r₃ → S.X₃.val.obj (op U)) (c : Fin r₃ → S.X₂.val.obj (op U)),
        (∀ i, S.g.val.app (op U) (c i) = b i) →
        φ.val.app (op U)
          (tmulSection (exteriorSheafSection S.X₁ r₁ U a)
            (exteriorSheafSection S.X₃ r₃ U b)) =
          exteriorSheafSection S.X₂ r₂ U
            (fun i ↦ Fin.append (fun j ↦ S.f.val.app (op U) (a j)) c (Fin.cast hr i))
